doc.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Opening and introduction
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Eddie Marshall for the Hamilton College archive.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m extremely pleased to have Eddie Marshall with me today, who is a drummer and composer and recordist.
We call you a recordist. Well it’s a pleasure to have you here.
Well it’s a pleasure to be invited here.
You were just talking before we were rolling about San Francisco has a fairly healthy music scene.
